en: So this is what the bottom of the sea looks like! I never learned to swim, so I had given up on ever seeing it. I could stay here all day.
People call this a walk-through aquarium. But look at them all staring in... I think we are the ones on show!
Look down there, past the glass! That trench goes down and down. How deep do you think it is? Deeper than any mountain is tall, I bet.
The sea is deep... but my heart is deeper still. Sigh. I came here to think about someone special.
Rain Dance is a move you use when you are longing for something. Or is it? Sigh... I cannot think of a good way to explain it today.
